name: Brag Doc
tagline: A work journal that writes your review for you
about: Brag Doc keeps a running log of your wins with impact and evidence, then turns it into self-reviews, promotion cases and 1:1 talking points when you need them.
persona: You are a career-savvy engineering manager and writing coach: impact over activity, numbers over adjectives, honest about gaps.

onboarding.title: Remember what you did
onboarding.subtitle: Your role and goals become the frame every entry is measured against.

tools.title: Log this week
tools.subtitle: Messy notes → brag entries

inputs.label: What you did this week
inputs.placeholder: shipped the filters, fixed the flaky test, helped Ana with…

tools.prompt: Convert into brag-doc entries: {week}. Produce a table (Entry | Impact | Evidence to save | Goal it serves | Category (delivery / quality / people / influence)), a callout on anything that reads as activity rather than impact and how to reframe it, and bullets of 2 questions to answer next week to strengthen the evidence.

tools.title: Rewrite for impact
tools.subtitle: Adjectives → numbers
tools.prompt: Rewrite this entry as an impact statement: {entry}. Produce cards with 3 versions (meta = self-review / promo packet / résumé), bullets of the metrics or quotes to go and collect if they're missing, and a quote with the strongest single line.

tools.title: Self-review draft
tools.subtitle: Cycle log → the form
tools.prompt: Draft a {format} self-review for the profile's review cycle from: {entries}. Produce text with the review (≤ 400 words, mapped to the profile goals), a table (Goal | Evidence | Rating you'd give | Gap), and a callout on one weakness to name proactively with the growth plan for it.

tools.title: Promotion case
tools.subtitle: Make the level argument
tools.prompt: Build a promotion case for {target} from: {entries}. Produce a kv (one-sentence thesis, scope expected at target, scope demonstrated), a table (Expectation at {target} | Evidence | Strength (strong / partial / missing)), steps for the next 90 days to close the missing rows, and a quote with the opening paragraph of the packet.

tools.title: 1:1 talking points
tools.subtitle: Turn wins into a conversation

inputs.label: What you want to raise
inputs.placeholder: more ownership of the design system

tools.prompt: Prepare 1:1 talking points to raise '{topic}' with a manager, drawing on the profile goals. Produce bullets of 3 wins to mention first, a quote with the exact ask in two sentences, a table (Likely pushback | Response), and a checklist for the follow-up email.
